svg.title: How Renovate runs for each repository
svg.desc: In the blueprint, a job with a token that only reads lists the repositories of the release app that may have rules for Renovate. Renovate then runs once for each of them, two at a time, each run with a token for its one repository, which the run looks at before Renovate starts. A last job, without the private key of the app, brings the log of every run into the one issue of Renovate's problems.
